page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Large display lines at the top, smaller lines below, a central woodcut or engraved device, and a small imprint at the foot. The library stamp sits over the centre and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is very faded and the title lines are mostly unreadable; the line counts and lengths are estimates. The large upper words and the small lines in the lower third could not be read with confidence. A library stamp (BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS) is over the centre and is excluded. A woodcut or engraved device fills the middle of the page. The foot carries a small imprint line and a date, which appear to read as a year in the 1570s, but this is not certain. Show-through from the reverse is present.
